name: Switzerland

flag.description: A square red flag with a white cross in the centre whose arms do not touch the edges; each arm is one-sixth longer than it is wide.
flag.symbolism: The white cross derives from the old banner of the canton of Schwyz and is commonly read as a Christian symbol; the flag stands for the Confederation's unity.

hook: A square red flag with a floating white plus sign: Switzerland is a plus, and its cross never touches the edges, unlike Denmark's.
trivia: Switzerland and Vatican City have the only square national flags; Swiss boats use a rectangular version.
The Red Cross emblem, created in 1864 in Geneva, reverses the colours of the Swiss flag in honour of Switzerland.
